_comment: The Dengage web application every demo talks to. Handoff 2.1.
This is the single place these two values are written down. The probe page,
the generator, the smoke test and the CI guardrails all read them from here,
so filling this in is the whole of wiring the repository to the panel.
Both are blank until the sandbox application exists. While they are blank the
probe page runs in dry run: it prints every payload it would send and sends
nothing, so the event shapes are reviewable before anyone holds a token.
accountId  the Dengage account. The core demos use 28 and the sandbox
application is a new application inside that same account, so
the Data Space and every contact are shared with them. That is
the reason for the table allowlist. Handoff 14.4.
appGuid    the sandbox application's guid, from the panel. The guardrails
treat this as an allowlist of one: any other application
identifier appearing anywhere in this repository is rejected,
so the identifier the core demos use never has to be written
down here in order to be kept out.
